caption_zh: GINav原生INS/IMU点的部分输出。圆圈标首个输出，叉号标最后输出，全部有限点保留，超过1.5秒间隔断线。三条记录分别仅77/275、2/271、5/378个输出；常规与遮挡记录触发原速度界限失败。淡灰POI参考路线只作地理背景，评价点不同，不用于计算本图位置误差。图中没有把部分输出称作完整运行。
caption_en: Partial GINav outputs at the native INS/IMU point. Circles and crosses identify first and last emitted outputs; all finite points are retained and gaps exceeding1.5s break the curves. Output support is77/275,2/271 and5/378; nominal and obstruction runs triggered the original speed-bound failure. The faint POI reference route provides geographic context only because the physical point differs; it is not used to score these plots.

notes.reference_role: POI context only; no same-point accuracy claim
